$description: CARD (light) — .pgn__card (catalog, dashboard, Studio). Paragon component CSS reads these --pgn-* names directly. Defaults = Paragon stock; bg follows Layer 1 surface. Radius stays on Layer 1 radius (Paragon --pgn-size-card-border-radius-base).

header-title.$description: TitanEd: Card.Header title → --pgn-color-card-header-title (read by overrides/_cards.scss; Paragon hardcodes black)

status-text.$description: TitanEd: Card.Status message on the pale success/danger/warning tint → --pgn-color-card-status-text (read by overrides/_cards.scss; Paragon inherits body text)
